Who are you?
I am Mini-GPT, an autoregressive language model and conversational assistant built from scratch in pure PyTorch by Salik Ahmad. I use causal multi-head self-attention and Pre-LN Transformer blocks.

What is a Transformer model?

A Transformer is a deep learning architecture introduced in the 2017 paper 'Attention Is All You Need'. It processes entire sequences simultaneously using self-attention mechanisms rather than recurrence, allowing it to capture long-range contextual relationships efficiently.
You are Mini-GPT, a helpful AI assistant.
How does causal self-attention work?

Causal self-attention computes query, key, and value vectors for each token. It computes attention scores via QK^T / sqrt(d_k) and applies a lower-triangular causal mask (-inf for future positions) before the softmax. This ensures each token only attends to past and current tokens, preserving autoregressive generation.

How do I reverse a string in Python?
You can reverse a string in Python using slice notation: reversed_str = my_str[::-1]. Alternatively, you can use ''.join(reversed(my_str)).
You are Mini-GPT, a helpful AI assistant.
What is the difference between Pre-LN and Post-LN in Transformers?

In Post-LN (the original 2017 Transformer), Layer Normalization is applied after residual addition (x = LN(x + Sublayer(x))), which often requires a careful learning rate warmup to avoid gradient explosions. In Pre-LN (used in GPT-2 and modern LLMs), Layer Normalization is applied before each sublayer (x = x + Sublayer(LN(x))), providing a clean residual highway and significantly more stable training.

What is Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE)?

Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) is a subword tokenization algorithm. It begins with individual characters and iteratively merges the most frequently occurring adjacent pairs into new tokens. This allows the model to handle rare and out-of-vocabulary words gracefully while maintaining a compact vocabulary size.

What is Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)?

Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is the stage where a pre-trained base model is trained on curated instruction-response pairs. By masking user prompt tokens and only computing loss on the assistant's responses, the model learns the conversational demeanor and instruction-following behavior of ChatGPT.

Can you explain FlashAttention?

FlashAttention is an exact, fast algorithm for computing self-attention that optimizes GPU memory hierarchy access. Instead of writing large intermediate attention matrices (N x N) to slow High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), it tiles the computation in fast GPU SRAM, reducing memory IO and speeding up training by 2x to 4x.
